# FCIImpurities

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIImpurities`

```text
FCIImpurities, version 0.01

Usage: FCIImpurities [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --input-states : ASCII column formatted file that describes the low energy states of the system without impurities
    --impurities : ASCII column formatted file that gives the location and strength of each impurity
    --import-onebody : import information on the tight binding model from a file
    --recompute-hilbert : do not store the Hilbert spaces (decreasing the memory consumption)

plot options:
    --output : output file name (default output name replace the .vec extension of the input file with .impurities.dat)
    --binary-output : export the eignestates as binary vectors instead of text files

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --use-precomputed : use precomputed matrix elements to perform the calculation

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
